rationale: Both Mufaddal and Abhinav work in firmware and embedded systems, with complementary skill sets that span the stack—Mufaddal brings deep automotive-grade embedded Linux and connectivity expertise (Bluetooth, OTA updates) from roles at LiveWire and Volkswagen, while Abhinav contributes hands-on firmware engineering at Microchip with developer tooling interests. This is a mutual match, and their overlap in embedded domains paired with Mufaddal's mentorship-level experience could create value for both technical collaboration and knowledge exchange.
